title: Signed layer-cake lower bound: ∫ζg dμ ≥ c·μ(B) from lower bounds on the superlevel sets of ζ (parent step 4)
statement: Let X be a type with a σ-algebra and μ a measure on X. Let ζ, g : X → ℝ be measurable with 0 ≤ ζ(x) ≤ 1 and |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. Let S ⊆ X be measurable with μ(S) < ∞ and ζ(x) = 0 for every x ∉ S. Let B ⊆ X be any set with ζ(x) = 1 for every x ∈ B, and let c ≥ 0. Suppose that c·μ({x : t ≤ ζ(x)})_ℝ ≤ ∫_{{x : t ≤ ζ(x)}} g dμ for every t with 0 < t ≤ 1. Then c·μ(B)_ℝ ≤ ∫_X ζ g dμ. Here μ(·)_ℝ = ENNReal.toReal and the integrals are Bochner integrals.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (ζ g : X → ℝ) (S B : Set X) (c : ℝ), Measurable ζ → Measurable g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → MeasurableSet S → μ S ≠ ∞ → (∀ x, x ∉ S → ζ x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ B, ζ x = 1) → 0 ≤ c → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 → c * (μ {x | t ≤ ζ x}).toReal ≤ ∫ x in {x | t ≤ ζ x}, g x ∂μ) → c * (μ B).toReal ≤ ∫ x, ζ x * g x ∂μ
